Description: Cognito User Pool for mandatory-TOTP-MFA-gated access to the dashboard and the inference API. No self-signup, no Hosted UI -- users are created via admin-create-user and log in through the dashboard's own LoginForm. Deploy BEFORE lambda-stack.json so the API requires auth from its first invocation. Usage: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file aws/auth-stack.json --stack-name distress-model-auth --region ap-south-1

UserPoolId.Description: Pass this as lambda-stack.json's CognitoUserPoolId parameter and dashboard's NEXT_PUBLIC_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID build var

UserPoolClientId.Description: Pass this as lambda-stack.json's CognitoClientId parameter and dashboard's NEXT_PUBLIC_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID build var
